reason: The hypothesis takes the well-known mechanism from P1 and P9 that sluggish diffusion stabilizes high-entropy alloy nanoparticles and simply inverts it: introducing a low-diffusion-barrier element will cause segregation. This is a direct restatement of the existing finding as a prediction, with the intervention being a trivial compositional change that the cited passages already imply would be destabilizing. No new mechanism, combination of sources, or transfer to a new regime is proposed.
copied_elements: sluggish diffusion and high diffusion barriers stabilize uniform elemental distribution (P1, P9)
lower diffusion barrier leads to faster diffusion and segregation (P1, P9)
entropy stabilization prevents phase separation (P1, P9)
